# Route caller coverage guard — baseline allowlist (fc-27)
# Format: <controller>#<action>   (one per line; # elsewhere means comment)
# Generated by inspecting RouteCallerCoverageChecker.non_internal_api_v1_routes
# against frontend/src, public+private extension frontend/src, MCP tools
# (server/app/services/ai/tools), extension server/app/services trees, the
# worker's jobs and services, and extension Go agents.
#
# These are the CURRENT non-internal api/v1 actions the two-tier heuristic
# (route_caller_coverage_checker.rb) cannot prove have a caller — some are
# real dead surface (candidates for a future fc-2x cleanup pass), some are
# heuristic false negatives (a caller exists behind an abstraction the
# literal/token matcher cannot see). Neither case is this guard's job to
# adjudicate: its job is catching a NEW route added with no caller, which it
# does by refusing to let route_caller_coverage_spec.rb pass on anything
# outside this baseline + the webhook allowlist. Shrinking this file (by
# wiring a real caller, or deleting genuinely dead routes) is welcome but
# is a separate, deliberate cleanup, not a side effect of this guard.
#
# ONE-WAY RATCHET: this file may shrink but never grow —
# route_caller_coverage_spec.rb pins its size to MAX_BASELINE_SIZE exactly
# (a shrink lowers the constant in the same diff) and fails on any entry
# naming a route that no longer exists or is now covered. A new caller-less
# route gets a caller or is deleted; it is never added here.
#
# Inbound webhook/callback receivers are NOT here — they have their own
# reasoned allowlist in route_caller_coverage_spec.rb (WEBHOOK_ALLOWLIST).
